articleTitle: A novel prolate spheroid infinite element
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 8th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory DIPED 2003
abstract: A novel prolate spheroid infinite element is proposed in this paper. This prolate spheroid infinite element is based on a new pressure representation that is a close solution for arbitrary scattered and/or radiated fields exterior to a prolate spheroid of any eccentricity. Example shows that the feasibility of the novel method is superior to other prolate spheroid acoustic infinite elements, especially at high frequencies and high aspect ratios.

articleTitle: Simple and double layer potentials in the Hilbert spaces
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 8th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory DIPED 2003
abstract: The boundary value problem for the Laplacian has numerous applications at the solution of the many applied problems of electrophysics. The Hilbert spaces elements of which can be represented as the sum of simple and double layer potentials are considered in this article. We prove that these spaces are orthogonal relatively the introduced scalar product and the elements of its union can be single-valuedly represented as a sum of above-mentioned potentials. Obtained results allow to formulate the independent classes of the boundary value problems for Laplacian in R/sup 3/ in these Hilbert spaces, to use the potential theory methods for its solution and to obtain the proof of well-posed solution for both boundary value problems and equivalent to the integral equations including the equations of the first kind.

articleTitle: On the convergence velocity of the modified method of successive approximations
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 8th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory DIPED 2003
abstract: The modified method of successive approximations is used to calculate characteristic number and corresponding eigenfunctions of a given linear completely continuous operator acting in a normed space. While the operator acts in a Gilbert space, the method converges as a geometrical progression with any small denominator. For certain operators we can execute steps of the method algorithm analytically. It allows us to separate the method error from the other ones and to estimate a posteriori the convergence velocity of the approximate results obtained by the method.

articleTitle: Software for the electro-thermal simulation of the human exposed to the mobile antenna radiation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 8th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory DIPED 2003
abstract: The computer program for electromagnetic (EM) and thermal analysis of the problems involving RF radiation and RF power absorption in complex environments including the models of living organisms is presented in this paper. The code is based on the finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) method for solving the EM problems, and the bioheat equation for predicting the temperature distribution in the complex objects (e.g. animals, human body). The software includes powerful GUI and scripting support for automated calculations and parametric study.

articleTitle: An integral equation solution of the Dirichlet and Neumann problems for the Laplacian in R/sup 3/
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 8th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory DIPED 2003
abstract: The Dirichlet and Neumann boundary value problems for the Laplacian in R/sup 3/ at the Hilbert space, the elements of which as well as their normal derivatives have the jump through boundary surface, are considered in an article. The conditions of well-posed solution of the formulated problems are determined. We suggest to look for the solution of these problems as the sum of the simple and double layer potentials. Integral equations equivalent to the above mentioned boundary value problems are the equations of the first kind. We define the conditions of the well-posed solution of the latter.

articleTitle: Properties of nonlinear Hammerstein integral equations connected with modified phase problem
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 8th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory DIPED 2003
abstract: Nonlinear integral equations of Hammerstein type arisen in the modified phase problem are investigated. A wide class of equations having analytical solutions is pointed out. A particular equation arisen in the problem of circular antenna synthesis is considered. Numerical results are presented.

articleTitle: The verification of the mathematical model of electromagnetic field distribution in the human head phantom from external sources
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 8th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory DIPED 2003
abstract: In the presented work the modeling of electromagnetic field from mobile phone distributed in the human head phantom was carried out. The modeling was done by integral equations method with unknown polarization currents induced by the mobile phone radiator. The currents and SAR distribution was defined in inhomogeneous environment with complex dielectrical permittivity. As a source the model of vibrator was used. The experimental verification of mathematical model was carried out.

articleTitle: Investigation of periodic multilayered metamaterial structures by the modernized translation matrix method
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 8th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory DIPED 2003
abstract: An inhomogeneous isotropic periodic medium with negative parameters is studied. Two similar approaches based on translation matrix method are considered. Comparison of these approaches is carried out. The reflection and propagation through layered slab are also studied.

articleTitle: Axial symmetric electromagnetic excitation of a finite conical screen by the magnetic ring source
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 8th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory DIPED 2003
abstract: In this paper we have analyzed the axial symmetric diffraction for a finite cone excited by the ring magnetic source rigorously using the technique based on an analytical inversion of the main part of asymptotic for initial set of linear algebraic equations and have investigated far field pattern and radiated power for different geometric parameters. The features of the far field behavior connected with the wave interaction between cone and ring source (particular when the source is located near the conical edge) has been shown.

articleTitle: The nonspecular wave reflection from a strip grating with a screened chiral layer
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 8th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory DIPED 2003
abstract: Wave polarization conversion is studied when a plane electromagnetic wave is nonspecularly reflected from the structure as a succession of layers in the order: strip grating, dielectric layer, chiral layer, and screen. The corresponding diffraction vector problem has been solved using the analytical regularization procedure, and the so obtained solution allows effective numerical treatment of the process. The autocollimation reflection and the nonspecular reflection with lager telescopicity coefficient have been found, when they proceed at the quasi total conversion of the plane-polarized incident wave into the space harmonic, whose polarization plane is normal to the incident wave polarization.

articleTitle: Elastodynamic stress in half-space resulting from a pressurized buried nonspherical cavity
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 8th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory DIPED 2003
abstract: The procedure to study the stresses in the vicinity of arbitrary-form cavity in elastic half-space is proposed. The surface of the cavity is under time-variable pressure. The procedure is based on utilization of Fourier integral time transform and method of null-field.

articleTitle: Effective boundary conditions for a thin curved layer imbedded in a homogeneous medium
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 8th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory DIPED 2003
abstract: Effective impedance boundary conditions for in a thin cylindrical curved layer imbedded in a homogeneous medium in conditions of different contacts are considered. Explicit forms of the second-order approximate boundary conditions are derived for a two-dimensional case. The methodology of investigation is based on the method of matched asymptotic expansions with the thickness-to-length ratio as the perturbation parameter.

articleTitle: The method of boundary integral equations for numerical investigation of prism and superprism effects in photonic crystals
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 8th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory DIPED 2003
abstract: A fast and accurate tool for numerical modeling of the prism and superprism effects is developed. Computation results obtained confirm that the dispersion of a light beam in a superprism based on photonic crystals is much stronger than the dispersion in ordinary dielectric prisms. These phenomena can be exploited in the fabrication of integrated microscale lightwave circuits consisting of devices such as wavelength-division multiplexed filters, add-drop multiplexers and dispersion compensators.

articleTitle: Carleman-Vekua method and longwave asymptotic in scattering problem by curvilinear strips
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 8th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory DIPED 2003
abstract: Using the theory of singular integral equations, the scattering problem of E-polarized wave from curvilinear strips has been formulated and solved for induced currents densities. In the case of narrow strips the solution obtained in the explicit form.

articleTitle: The electrostatic and magnetostatic potentials of fractal objects
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 8th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory DIPED 2003
abstract: We have considered stationary electric and magnetic fields of fractal objects with the help of differ-integration methods. The equations of fractal electrostatic and magnetostatic potential at integro-differential form are proved and introduced. The obtained structures of stationary fields are graphically shown in a 'Mandelbrot Set' and 'Koch Snowflake' fractals examples. The offered ideas can be useful for modification numeric fields modelling techniques to solve electromagnetic problems for real objects with material structure irregularities consideration.

articleTitle: Exact radiation conditions in vector electromagnetic initial boundary-value problems for compact inhomogeneities of free space
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 8th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory DIPED 2003
abstract: Exact radiation conditions are developed that allows proper and efficient truncation of the computational domain in finite-difference methods used for solving open vector problems of the theory of nonsinusoidal waves. The initial boundary-value problems describe transient states of the electromagnetic fields generated by current and momentary source in the part of the R/sup 3/-space containing compact metal-dielectric inhomogeneities.

articleTitle: Modelling of electromagnetic wave propagation in the turbulent flow with resonance absorption
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 8th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory DIPED 2003
abstract: The purpose of this work is exploration of the process of electromagnetic wave multiple interactions with moving turbulent inhomogeneities in the flow of slightly ionized plasma with resonance absorption. The method of stochastic modelling is applied to the analysis of this problem. Here is considered the propagation of waves with arbitrary frequency spectrum in the plane-parallel turbulent flow with inhomogeneous profiles of velocity and concentration of turbulences. The results of calculations are demonstrated the substantial dependence of frequency spectrum shape of scattering wave from the degree of inhomogeneous of velocity and concentration profiles.

articleTitle: Input impedance of an antenna array microstrip radiator
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 8th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory DIPED 2003
abstract: The algorithm of the calculation of input impedance of an antenna array microstrip radiator is based on a double solution of scattering problem of the monochromatic plane wave by a periodic antenna array of the printed radiators. The result of these problems solution is the surface densities, as magnetic current on the aperture of an antenna array, lice from the microstrip elements, and electrical current on printed radiators. The development of microstrip radiator equivalent circuit (Thevenin's circuit) is necessary in the procedure of input impedance calculation of an antenna array printed radiator. The magnetic current in the aperture of an antenna array, where each microstrip element has a gap in a place of supposed connection of a lumped voltage source, is determined in the first case. The result of the first problem solution is the calculation of an open-circuit voltage. The electrical current on the microstrip element of an antenna array, where places of supposed the feeder connection have been /spl Lt/metallized/spl Gt/, is searched in the second case. The result of the second problem solution is the calculation of a short-circuit current. From the open-circuit voltage and the short-circuit current, the Thevenin circuit impedance of the microstrip radiator of an antenna array can be calculated.

articleTitle: Antenna arrays synthesis by the given amplitude directivity pattern with due regard for the mutual coupling of radiators
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 8th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory DIPED 2003
abstract: This paper described a numerical method of solving the synthesis problems of the antenna arrays by the given amplitude directivity pattern (DP), which takes into account the mutual coupling of radiators. For solving the analysis problem we used the sharp electrodynamics and appropriate mathematical models of antenna array, that gives an opportunity to regard the vector character of the electromagnetic field and the mutual coupling of radiators. Smoothing functionals are used for the variational statements of the amplitude-phase and phase synthesis problems. The existence theorems are proved, the numerical algorithms for solutions finding are constructed and justified. It is shown that nonlinear synthesis problems have nonunique solutions, their number and the qualitative characteristics depend on properties of the given amplitude DP symmetry and electrical sizes of the array.

articleTitle: Comparison of two optimization criteria for power transmission lines
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 8th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory DIPED 2003
abstract: A problem of comparison of two optimization criteria for antenna-rectenna power transmission lines is considered. The behavior of each criterion on functions optimal for another is studied. Numerical results for rectangular and circular apertures are shown and analyzed.

articleTitle: Parametric synthesis of transparency function of semitransparent partition in irregular waveguide
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 8th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory DIPED 2003
abstract: The problem of transparency function synthesis in irregular 2D waveguide is solved. The transparency function is represented as a polynomial of the second degree. The field in a regular part of the waveguide is represented by series with arbitrary coefficients. One of these coefficients in the regular part of the waveguide is optimized.

articleTitle: Investigation of antenna radiation influence on human head (2D case)
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 8th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory DIPED 2003
abstract: The paper presents investigations of mobile phone antenna influence on the human head. In this research structural heterogeneous model of human head with different electrodynamic behavior of tissues and air holes was used. EM analyses have been performed via the 2D finite-difference time-domain method (FDTD).

articleTitle: Method of degenerate kernels for solution of two-dimensional non-linear Hammerstein integral equations, arising in antenna synthesis problems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 8th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory DIPED 2003
abstract: The generalization of degenerate kernels method, utilized for solution of linear integral equations in the case of non-linear Hammerstein equations, using the finite number of kernel eigenfunctions, is given. The convergence of solution of the approximate equation to the solution of the exact equation is substantiated.

articleTitle: Software creation for the simulation of the mobile phone antennas interaction with human
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 8th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory DIPED 2003
abstract: Development of the personal communication systems (PCS), such as mobile phones increases interest for the investigation of the antennas interaction with human. A numerical methods and software packages based on these methods have a great importance. In the present work engineer-oriented software package for the simulation antenna-human interaction has been created.

articleTitle: Highfrequency electrodynamics for the last half century
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 8th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory DIPED 2003
abstract: The paper presents a brief review of the major trends in high frequency electrodynamics for recent years. It gives a list of the new ideas and methods which were introduced then, and sketches the principal problems that appeared, namely, complex and associated waves in waveguides, the two-plain-mirror high quality resonator and spectral theory of open resonators.

articleTitle: Equivalent circuit approach in solution of low frequency automotive EMC problems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 8th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory DIPED 2003
abstract: This paper proposes the multi-step equivalent circuit approach as an effective solution for low frequency EMC problems arising in car industry. We first solve the 3D quasi-static problem and extract the capacitance and inductance coefficient matrices. Then, the equivalent circuit is generated. Lastly, we perform AC analysis in the low frequency range to determine the coupled voltages and currents with the sufficient accuracy. The proposed approach is much faster compared with direct MoM calculations, and can be used in time as well as in the frequency domain. This approach also gives a link to circuit simulation programs for modeling of complex, nonlinear terminating devices.

articleTitle: Non-reciprocal polarization effects in diffraction by a planar chiral array
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 8th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory DIPED 2003
abstract: We found apparent nonreciprocity in the polarization transformation of a wave diffracted by a planar-chiral double periodic array.

articleTitle: Electrodynamic characteristics of the multilayered semiconductor-dielectric structure with diffraction grating
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 8th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory DIPED 2003
abstract: The interaction of electromagnetic plane wave with multilayered semiconductor-dielectric structure with diffraction grating is studied. The algebraic set of equations of Fredholm type of second kind has been obtained. The reflection coefficient is numerically determined. It is shown that it can be less than unity (wave amplification) as well as less than unity (wave absorption).

articleTitle: Scattering statistics of Doppler faded acoustic signals using speckle noise models
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 8th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory DIPED 2003
abstract: Understanding scattering multipath channels that fade randomly with respect to time, frequency, and space is very crucial for the accurate detection of objects and the study of their scattering characteristics when mapped by active radar or sonar systems. In this paper, we derive stochastic models for the probability density function (pdf) of the shift in the carrier frequency caused by the Doppler effect on the received illuminating signal. Our derivation is based on single- and multi-look partially developed speckle noise models, which are in perfect agreement with the Doppler spread in the Clarke's model. Finally, we study the problem of object detection in randomly faded channels by analogy to optimal detection of binary phase shift keying signals in digital communication.

articleTitle: Calculation and measuring of electromagnetic fields in near zone
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 8th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory DIPED 2003
abstract: Some peculiarities of determination of the electrical E and magnetic H components of field strength near the field source (in the near zone) are considered in the report. It is shown that in such cases calculation methods do not take into account many factors that can essentially distort the calculation results.

articleTitle: Determination of multilayered permittivity profile from specified angular dependence of reflection coefficient
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 8th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory DIPED 2003
abstract: The solution of inverse scattering problem (ISP) for oblique incidence of electromagnetic plane wave on multilayered (ML) structure is presented in the paper. The investigation covers a case, where angular dependence of reflection coefficient of the plane structure with varying permittivity profile is used as initial data. Solution of this problem involves reduction of field equations to Schrodinger's one as well as applying of the Gelfand, Levitan and Marchenko (GLM) theory for the determination of permittivity profile according to known scattering characteristics.

articleTitle: Inverse problem for acoustical tomography of stress fields in piecewise-homogeneous strip
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 8th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory DIPED 2003
abstract: The piecewise-homogeneous strip {x/spl epsi/(-/spl infin/,0),y/spl epsi/[-1,1]}/spl cup/{x/spl epsi/(0,/spl infin/),y/spl epsi/[-1,1]} consisting of two semi-infinite strips is considered. Direct and inverse problems for determination of residual stresses, that are caused by the differences on the temperature expansion coefficients and the elastic characteristics of the two different parts of the strip are considered. To formulate the inverse problem the data, which can be obtained with acoustic measurements, are used. To solve the problems a variation method are used.

articleTitle: To a question on the mechanism of formation of ionospheric disturbances at groundbased artificial acoustic excitation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 8th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory DIPED 2003
abstract: The question on the mechanism of influence on an ionosphere of the artificial acoustic disturbances created by the controlled acoustic radiator, substantially remains open. It is connected both to complexity of a problem of interpretation, and with short time of researches for the lack of controlled sources of acoustic disturbances. Questions of influence of explosions and earthquakes on an ionosphere are more investigated. The nearest physical factor of influence on an ionosphere, to artificial acoustic disturbance, explosions are similar. Physical processes of propagation of an acoustic field and mechanisms of formation of ionospheric disturbances at explosions are considered. On the basis of it are offered, as hypothesis, probable "scripts" of propagation and registration of an acoustic field, and also formation of ionospheric disturbances at the acoustic excitation generated on a surface of the Earth with the help of the controlled acoustic radiator.

articleTitle: Effective Lagrangians of the electromagnetic field in dispersive media
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 8th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory DIPED 2003
abstract: Electromagnetic field in dispersive dielectric media can be described in the framework of effective field theory. The interaction between the electromagnetic field and the medium on microscopic level is described by a modified Hopfield Lagrangian. The effective theory is obtained by elimination of the matter degrees of freedom, by means of the functional integration over the matter fields. From the effective Lagrangian, that describes the properties of the medium, we can obtain eg. an expression for the frequency dependent dielectric constant. The nonlinearity of the dielectric medium is treated as a perturbation since in this case the functional integration cannot be performed using Gaussian integrals.

articleTitle: Signal analysis of electromagnetic defectoscopy of rails by non-stationary statistic methods
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 8th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory DIPED 2003
abstract: An example of using the statistical analysis for detection and classification of rail defects from logged signals of magnetic-dynamic inspection train is provided in this paper.

articleTitle: Simulation of optical control devices based on photonic band structures
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 8th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory DIPED 2003
abstract: The software package for photonic crystals based microwave and optical devices development has been created. The possibility of microwave devices analogues in nanotechnologies using PBG structures based on complex materials creation is proved and illustrated. The results of simulation, such as waveguides, diplexer and some antenna devices are presented. The method of discontinuity modeling in PBG-based waveguides is given.

articleTitle: Scattering of a plane electromagnetic wave by an infinite double-ridge conductive wedge with a dielectric-coated axially slotted cylinder at the crest
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 8th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory DIPED 2003
abstract: We reduce the considered problem to solving a matrix equation of the second kind for unknown coefficients of a scattered field into a Fourier series. This expansion was obtained by imposing boundary conditions on the scattered field with the subsequent re-expansion of the field function over basis functions in a given interval. The expansion coefficients of the scattered field were determined analytically in the case where the electric diameter of the dielectric-coated axially slotted cylinder is less than unity. Scattered far-field (SFF) of the structure is evaluated asymptotically. Is shown that the shape of scattering-field pattern for that limitation is similar to the cardioid for the case of an E-polarized incident wave.

articleTitle: Nonlinear problems of radiating systems synthesis (theory and methods of solution)
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 8th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory DIPED 2003

articleTitle: Algorithms of the diffraction problem solution of a plane wave on nonlinear dielectric layer
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 8th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory DIPED 2003
abstract: On an example of the open nonlinear electrodynamic system - transverse non-homogeneous, isotropic, nonlinear (a Kerr-like dielectric nonlinearity) dielectric layer, the algorithms of solution of the diffraction problem of a plane wave on the nonlinear object is shown. The first of them based on the iterative scheme is applicable to the solution of non-homogeneous system of the second kind nonlinear equations. The second algorithm bases on Newtonian method of solution of the nonlinear equations system.

articleTitle: Radiating impedance end face of rectangular waveguide
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 8th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory DIPED 2003
abstract: The approximate analytical solution of the problem of the basic wave-mode diffraction on the narrow slot what is cut in the impedance end face wall of the finite thickness have been obtained by the induced magnetomotive forces method. It is proposed that waveguide is half-infinite and the slot radiates into the free space over the infinite ideally conducting screen. The scattering matrix coefficients were numerically investigated in the case when values of the complex surface impedance correspond to some concrete realization of the film coating of the waveguide end face wall.

articleTitle: Waveguide array synthesis using the power criterion
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 8th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory DIPED 2003
abstract: The synthesis problem of the waveguide array according to the prescribed power radiation pattern is considered. The mutual coupling of the separate elements of array is taken into account in the process of solution of a direct problem (analysis problem). Variational statement of the synthesis problem is used. The functional representing a mean-square deviation of the prescribed and received power radiation patterns is minimized. The appropriate nonlinear equation is reduced; the properties of its solutions are investigated.

articleTitle: Linear microstrip beam scanning antenna array
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 8th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory DIPED 2003
abstract: Linear microstrip antenna array (MSAA) consisting of rectangular patches with specified directional diagram and ability to perform a beam scanning has been calculated in approximation of the given surface current distribution. Constructive synthesis of such an array, considering matching of its elements with the feeding lines, has been done. Irradiation characteristics of the given array have been analyzed.

articleTitle: Physical models of the wireless power transmission systems in optical and microwave ranges
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 8th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory DIPED 2003
abstract: It should be intended two aspects upon the physical modeling conditions of a microwave power transmission system. These are some method modeling, and proper means modeling. Some amplitude and phase distributions of the radiated and received fields relate to the former aspect. Some plug-compatible versions of the methods relate to the latter aspect. Original study results relating to the former aspect are analyzed.

articleTitle: Variational approach to solution of nonlinear vector spectral problem for the case of self-adjoint positively semi-defined operators
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 8th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory DIPED 2003
abstract: The variational approach to solution of generalized eigenvalue problem with nonlinear occurrence of the vector spectral parameter is presented. The equivalence of spectral problem and corresponding variational problem are proved. The idea of coordinate-wise descent is the basis of numerical algorithm for minimization of the functional that is the square of the norm of misclosure of homogenous operator equation. The relaxation properties of the constructed iteration process are proved.

articleTitle: Investigation of the field distribution inside rooms located near the basic antenna stations
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 8th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory DIPED 2003
abstract: In this article we present a numerical study of EMC problems related to the dangerous resonance enhancement of the electromagnetic (EM) field inside living room placed near the basic antenna stations. Using computer simulation we have investigated the propagation EM fields and resonance characteristics and high field areas inside simple room model built with iron-beton material. The mathematical approach based on the method of auxiliary sources (MAS) [R. Zaridze et al., 2002] is used to solve this problem.

articleTitle: Proceedings of 8th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory. DIPED-2003 (IEEE Cat. No.03TH8689)
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 8th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory DIPED 2003
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: complex media; diffraction; numerical methods; antennas; transmission lines; mobile antenna radiation; acoustics; and field measurements.

IEEE Keywords: Components, Packaging, and Manufacturing Technology Society

articleTitle: Influence of the distance from the mobile antenna to head on the SAR investigation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 8th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory DIPED 2003
abstract: In this paper the investigation of the influence of the distance from the antenna to the users head on the antenna input impedance and maximum SAR value is presented.

articleTitle: Realistic model of personal communication systems (PCS) antenna and its interaction study with the user
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 8th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory DIPED 2003
abstract: The objectives of the presented paper is investigation of a new type of health safety antenna for PCS with optimal geometric size and shape to provide desirable electric and radiation characteristics and study its interaction with the user, also creation of user-friendly program package for computer simulation.

articleTitle: The numerical methods for the analysis of the diffraction problems of a plane electromagnetic wave by a wavy boundary between two media
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 8th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory DIPED 2003
abstract: The present article is a study of the reflection of the field of a plane electromagnetic wave from an irregular boundary. We investigate two mathematical models for solving the problem of reflection of a plane E- and H-polarized electromagnetic waves from an irregular media interface. These problems appear in radar imaging of the water surface of the Earth. In constructing a mathematical model, it is necessary to take into consideration the geometry of the irradiated surface, the electrodynamic parameters of the medium, and the character of the incident field. For visuality, all calculations in this paper were carried out for normal incidence of the plane wave. The proposed algorithms also permit performing computational experiment in the case of inclined incidence of a plane wave.

articleTitle: Application of integrodifferential calculus in electrodynamics of complex medium
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 8th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory DIPED 2003
abstract: We will consider the geometric and physical aspects that permit introduction of the so-called /spl alpha/-characteristics for studying the behaviour of electromagnetic field components in the vicinity of a set of points with fractal properties. To estimate the /spl alpha/-characteristics, possible algorithms are formulated, namely a geometric one involving equation of the Hausdorff measure and an analytical algorithm permitting the Hausdorff measure to be evaluated through application of fractional derivatives and integrals. The algorithms relate both to solutions of integral Maxwell's equations (Abel integral equations) for problems characterised by charge and current distributions at fractal interfaces between media, and the differential Helmholtz equation with fractal boundary conditions.

articleTitle: Authors index
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 8th International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory DIPED 2003
abstract: The author index contains an entry for each author and coauthor included in the proceedings record.
